# Burke Center

> > Burke Center provides mental health, substance use, developmental disabilities, and early childhood intervention services across East Texas.

Burke Center serves multiple counties in East Texas including Angelina County and Lufkin, offering crisis hotlines, detoxification programs, IDD services, veteran support through the Military Veterans Peer Network, and community mental health resources. The organization is led by CEO Melanie Taylor and works in partnership with the Alcohol and Drug Abuse Council (ADAC).

## Key Topics

- Mental health services
- Substance use treatment
- Developmental disabilities (IDD)
- Early childhood intervention
- Crisis hotline and suicide prevention
- Veterans services and Military Veterans Peer Network
- Burke/ADAC detoxification program
- Texas mental health resources
- Depression and teen suicide statistics
- East Texas community mental health
- Patient rights and consumer advocacy
- Leadership: Melanie Taylor and Susan Rushing
- Board of Trustees
- Lufkin and Angelina County services

- [September is Suicide Prevention Awareness Month](https://myburke.org/september-is-suicide-prevention-awareness-month): Suicide Prevention Awareness Month resources and crisis hotline info

- [Lufkin Woman Finds Hope from Depression in Music](https://myburke.org/lufkin-woman-finds-hope-from-depression-in-music): Personal recovery story: Lufkin woman overcomes depression through music
